FAQS.q: How do I access my course or pack after payment?
FAQS.a: After we confirm your payment, you get your course login or download link on WhatsApp and email, usually within a few hours. You keep lifetime access.

FAQS.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
FAQS.a: We accept eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay QR, mobile banking and bank transfer. International customers can pay by card through our partner gateway.

FAQS.q: How long does today's discount last?
FAQS.a: Each day's offer runs until the timer hits zero at midnight (Nepal time), then the next day's offer begins. Order before the timer ends to get today's price.

FAQS.q: How does Facebook boost work if I don't have a dollar card?
FAQS.a: You pay us in NPR and we run the ads from our verified ad accounts on your page. You just add us as a partner; we handle the rest and send you results.

FAQS.q: Can I request a custom design or video package?
FAQS.a: Absolutely. Contact us with your requirement and we'll send you a custom quote within 24 hours.

FAQS.q: Can I become a teacher on Digital Saathi?
FAQS.a: Yes! If you're skilled in design, video, marketing or tech, apply on our Teachers page. We help you record, publish and sell your course.
